scenario: All-provider workflow-default installation, hook integration, project discovery, task routing, isolated syntax checking, reviewed project test execution, evidence and release gates, all-mode upgrade, workflow pruning, provider removal, and pre-first-install baseline restoration.
limitations: Provider client applications were not launched; generated provider files, policies, skill counts, hooks, and lifecycle behavior were tested.
Project-defined commands execute as local processes without an OS filesystem or network sandbox; review and per-invocation trust are required.
The scenario exercises Python and all provider installers, not every supported programming ecosystem.
